errors.text_span: die von der Mindestlohnanhebung auf 12 Euro betroffen sind
errors.evidence: The description includes information from the paper's caption about the context of the data (impact of a minimum wage increase). This information is not present in the chart itself, whose title is simply 'Anteil an allen Betrieben in %' (Share of all companies in %).
The chart displays four categories for company size ('Größere Betriebe', 'Mittlere Betriebe', 'Kleinbetriebe', 'Kleinstbetriebe'), not three as stated in the description.

errors.text_span: die Kategorien sind nicht alphabetisch, sondern nach abnehmendem Betroffenheitsanteil sortiert
errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization. Only the top block of 19 economic sectors is sorted in descending order of value. The bottom block of four company size categories is not sorted by value.
The bar for 'Einzelhandel' clearly ends before the 40% mark, at a value of approximately 38%.

errors.text_span: „Baugewerbe“ und „Finanz- und Versicherungsgewerbe“ liegen mit jeweils etwa 10 % am unteren Ende der Branchen
errors.evidence: The values for these two categories are not 'each about 10%'. 'Baugewerbe' has the lowest value in the sector group at about 8%, while 'Finanz- und Versicherungsgewerbe' is at about 12%.
The description lists values for only three of the four company size categories, completely omitting 'Kleinbetriebe (10-49)', which has a value of approximately 30%.
